newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks claw back to set new high at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks claw back to set new high at close.

text.p: Madrid stocks managed a slight gain at the close on Monday, ending above Ibex resistance at 5,500 and a new high, dealers said.
Although weaker blue chips were off lows, the outlook was still mixed, with uncertainty setting the tone for the bourse.
The general index rose 1.29 points, 0.27 percent, to 481.95 and the Ibex added 9.87 points, 0.18 percent to 5,509.14.
Weakness in key stocks was seen as technical. Endesa shed 140 pesetas to 9,150 while Repsol dropped 90 pesetas to 5,570.
Telefonica ended 40 pesetas lower at 3,360 ahead of pricing for privatisation of government's last 20.9 percent stake.
The session was mixed, although fairly dull amid a lack of new ideas and few fresh trading incentives.
If the Ibex manages to consolidate gains above 5,500, the bourse could rally further medium term, dealers said. But otherwise a further retracement could occur.
